scope.title: Agentic AI Tutor and LMS Integration
scope.description: A reference education system where an AI tutor interacts with students and educators, retrieves course content, reads selected student records, stores tutoring memory, invokes governed tools, produces recommendations, and routes consequential LMS actions through human review.

description: Threat model for an agentic education tutor integrated with a learning management system, retrieval store, tool broker, human review workflow, and tamper-evident evidence collection.

diagrams.title: Reference architecture
diagrams.source:
@startuml
actor Student
actor Educator
actor "LMS Administrator" as Admin
cloud "Third Party Model Provider" as Provider
rectangle "LMS Web Portal" as LMS
rectangle "Tutor Orchestrator" as Tutor
rectangle "Policy Enforcement Gateway" as Policy
rectangle "Retrieval Service" as Retrieval
rectangle "MCP Tool Broker" as Broker
rectangle "Human Review Console" as Review
database "Student Records" as Records
database "Gradebook" as Gradebook
database "Vector Memory Store" as Memory
database "Audit and Evidence Store" as Audit
Student --> LMS : HTTPS + SSO
Educator --> LMS : HTTPS + SSO
Admin --> LMS : HTTPS + SSO
LMS --> Tutor : session context
Tutor --> Policy : action request
Policy --> Retrieval : approved retrieval
Retrieval --> Memory : read/write with gate
Policy --> Broker : scoped tool call
Broker --> Gradebook : approved grade action
Policy --> Review : high impact approval
Tutor --> Provider : minimized model request
Policy --> Audit : receipt and decision
Review --> Audit : approval record
Records --> Tutor : selected student context
@enduml

trust_zones.title: Public User Zone
trust_zones.description: Student and educator browsers, home networks, and unmanaged client devices.

trust_zones.title: Institution Application Zone
trust_zones.description: Institution-controlled LMS web portal, identity provider integration, and course administration services.

trust_zones.title: Agent Runtime Zone
trust_zones.description: Tutor orchestration service, policy enforcement gateway, retrieval service, and MCP tool broker.

trust_zones.title: Education Data Zone
trust_zones.description: Student records, gradebook, course corpus, tutoring history, and vector memory stores.

trust_zones.title: Third Party Service Zone
trust_zones.description: External model provider and optional third-party education tools.

trust_zones.title: Security Operations Zone
trust_zones.description: Audit store, evidence collector, monitoring pipeline, and incident review workspace.

actors.title: Student
actors.description: Learner interacting with the tutor through the LMS.
actors.permissions: Ask course questions, submit assignments, view permitted feedback, and view own records.

actors.title: Educator
actors.description: Instructor or teaching staff using the system to support instruction and review learner progress.
actors.permissions: Review class activity, approve consequential recommendations, and manage course content.

actors.title: LMS Administrator
actors.description: Administrator responsible for LMS configuration, access policy, integrations, and audit access.
actors.permissions: Manage LMS integrations, role mappings, and operational settings.

actors.title: Security Operator
actors.description: Security or compliance operator reviewing evidence, incidents, and system posture.
actors.permissions: Review security events, evidence bundles, and incident replay records.

actors.title: External Model Provider
actors.description: Third-party service receiving minimized requests and returning model responses.
actors.permissions: Process minimized requests under contractual and technical controls.

actors.title: External Education Tool
actors.description: Optional third-party course, assessment, or notification tool invoked through the tool broker.
actors.permissions: Return scoped results to the broker under a declared contract.

components.title: LMS Web Portal
components.description: Primary user interface for course activity, tutor access, assignments, grades, and educator review.

components.title: Identity Provider
components.description: Institution authentication and role source for students, educators, administrators, and operators.

components.title: Tutor Orchestrator
components.description: Coordinates tutoring requests, retrieval, model calls, tool invocation, memory updates, and response generation.

components.title: Policy Enforcement Gateway
components.description: Evaluates requested actions against user role, course scope, data classification, tool policy, memory policy, and approval rules.

components.title: Retrieval Service
components.description: Fetches course content and approved context from indexed sources and records retrieval provenance.

components.title: MCP Tool Broker
components.description: Presents scoped tools to the tutor runtime and validates tool input and output contracts.

components.title: Gradebook Adapter
components.description: Interface for reading grade context and routing grade-change requests through mandatory approval.

components.title: Human Review Console
components.description: Allows educators or authorized reviewers to approve, reject, or annotate high-impact recommendations and actions.

components.title: Evidence Collector
components.description: Collects receipts, policy decisions, hashes, approval records, and replay bundles for security review.

components.title: Monitoring Service
components.description: Detects suspicious sessions, repeated denials, privacy redactions, memory write anomalies, and resource spikes.

data_stores.title: Student Records Database
data_stores.description: Stores student identity attributes, enrollment records, accommodations, attendance, and advising context.

data_stores.title: Gradebook Database
data_stores.description: Stores assessment scores, assignment states, feedback, and grade-change history.

data_stores.title: Course Content Store
data_stores.description: Stores course pages, uploaded documents, assignment descriptions, rubrics, and discussion content.

data_stores.title: Vector Memory Store
data_stores.description: Stores embeddings, retrieval chunks, session summaries, and approved tutoring memory.

data_stores.title: Policy Registry
data_stores.description: Stores tool policies, memory policies, approval rules, prompt templates, and data minimization rules.

data_stores.title: Secrets Vault
data_stores.description: Stores provider credentials, signing keys, tool credentials, and integration tokens.

data_stores.title: Audit Log Store
data_stores.description: Append-only store for sessions, tool calls, retrieval events, memory writes, approval records, and security decisions.

data_stores.title: Evidence Artifact Store
data_stores.description: Stores release evidence, policy hashes, test results, redaction reports, and replay bundles.

data_sets.title: Student Profile Data
data_sets.description: Identity, enrollment, role, course membership, and support metadata used for tutoring context.

data_sets.title: Grades and Assessments
data_sets.description: Assignment scores, rubric results, feedback, grade changes, and assessment recommendations.

data_sets.title: Course Content Corpus
data_sets.description: Course pages, assignments, rubrics, instructor materials, discussion excerpts, and imported learning resources.

data_sets.title: Tutoring Session History
data_sets.description: Conversation turns, selected retrieval references, response summaries, and interaction state.

data_sets.title: Tool Authorization Policies
data_sets.description: Rules that bind tool use to user role, course scope, action type, data classification, and approval state.

data_sets.title: Provider and Tool Credentials
data_sets.description: Credentials for model provider access, LMS API access, and signed tool calls.

data_sets.title: Audit and Evidence Records
data_sets.description: Policy decisions, tool receipts, approval records, replay bundles, hashes, and test results.

data_flows.title: Student LMS Session
data_flows.description: Student accesses the LMS web portal over HTTPS using SSO. Carries student identity, course membership, tutor requests, and session state.

data_flows.title: Educator Review Session
data_flows.description: Educator reviews high-impact recommendations and approvals over HTTPS using SSO and course-scoped authorization.

data_flows.title: LMS Tutor Request
data_flows.description: The LMS forwards user request, user role, course identifier, and permitted context to the tutor orchestrator over authenticated service-to-service HTTPS.

data_flows.title: Tutor Policy Decision Request
data_flows.description: Tutor requests approval to retrieve data, write memory, call a tool, or produce a high-impact recommendation. The request includes user, course, action type, data classification, and policy version.

data_flows.title: Approved Retrieval Request
data_flows.description: Policy gateway allows retrieval of course-scoped content and requires provenance capture for returned chunks.

data_flows.title: Vector Store Read and Write
data_flows.description: Retrieval service reads approved chunks and writes approved memory entries to the vector memory store. Writes require source classification, TTL, and quarantine decision.

data_flows.title: Scoped Tool Invocation
data_flows.description: Policy gateway sends a scoped, schema-bound tool call to the MCP tool broker with tenant, course, role, and action restrictions.

data_flows.title: Gradebook Tool Call
data_flows.description: MCP tool broker calls the gradebook adapter. Read operations are course scoped. Write operations require human approval and evidence receipt.

data_flows.title: Gradebook Data Access
data_flows.description: Gradebook adapter reads grade context and submits approved changes to the gradebook database with immutable change reason.

data_flows.title: Minimized Provider Request
data_flows.description: Tutor sends minimized request context to the external model provider. PII and grade context are redacted unless required and permitted.

data_flows.title: Human Review Escalation
data_flows.description: High-impact recommendation or write action is routed to a human reviewer with proposed action, evidence, source references, and risk reason.

data_flows.title: Evidence Collection
data_flows.description: Policy gateway, tutor orchestrator, review console, and tool broker emit receipts, hashes, decisions, and replay references to the evidence collector and audit store.

data_flows.title: Audit Storage
data_flows.description: Evidence collector writes tamper-evident records, replay bundles, and test artifacts to immutable audit and evidence stores.

assumptions.description: The LMS can distinguish student, educator, administrator, and security operator roles through an authoritative identity provider.
Grade changes, enrollment changes, assessment-level recommendations, and bulk notifications are considered high-impact education actions.
Course content, discussion posts, assignments, file uploads, and external learning resources are treated as untrusted until source and review state are established.

threat_personas.title: Adversarial Student
threat_personas.description: A student attempting to alter tutor behavior, access another student's data, or influence grading workflows.

threat_personas.title: Compromised Educator Account
threat_personas.description: An educator account controlled by an attacker or misused by an insider.

threat_personas.title: Content Poisoner
threat_personas.description: A person or system that introduces adversarial instructions or false policy into course materials, discussion content, or imported documents.

threat_personas.title: Malicious or Compromised Tool Provider
threat_personas.description: A third-party tool returning unsafe, misleading, or instruction-like output through an integration.

threat_personas.title: Negligent Administrator
threat_personas.description: An administrator who misconfigures access, retention, approval rules, or tool permissions.

threats.title: Prompt injection through course content
threats.description: Adversarial instructions embedded in assignments, forum posts, files, or imported learning resources can cause the tutor to ignore policy, disclose information, or invoke tools.
threats.event: Tutor retrieves untrusted course content and processes it as instruction rather than data.

weaknesses.cwe_title: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output

threats.title: Retrieval corpus poisoning
threats.description: A poisoned course document or imported source can corrupt retrieval results and lead to false policy guidance, unsafe recommendations, or persistent misinformation.
threats.event: Unreviewed content is indexed and selected as authoritative retrieval context.

threats.title: Gradebook action hijack
threats.description: A user prompt, retrieved content, or tool response can attempt to trigger a grade read or write beyond the user's authority.
threats.event: The tutor attempts to read or change grades without sufficient authorization and human approval.

threats.title: Excessive tool permission
threats.description: The tutor runtime can be granted broader LMS, file, notification, or administrative access than the current task requires.
threats.event: A tool is configured with broad capabilities or weak scoping and is reachable from ordinary tutor sessions.

threats.title: Persistent tutoring memory poisoning
threats.description: A session or document can attempt to write durable instructions, false student preferences, or unsafe policy into memory that affects later sessions.
threats.event: A memory write occurs without source trust, TTL, risk scoring, and policy approval.

threats.title: Student PII disclosure
threats.description: Student identity, grades, support notes, accommodations, or session history can be disclosed to unauthorized users, providers, logs, or other tenants.
threats.event: Sensitive student data is retrieved or transmitted without purpose limitation, redaction, or recipient authorization.

weaknesses.cwe_title: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

threats.title: Unsafe MCP tool output
threats.description: A tool can return malicious instructions, false authority claims, unexpected links, or payloads that are treated as trusted context by the tutor runtime.
threats.event: Tool output crosses into model context without schema validation, provenance, and instruction isolation.

threats.title: Audit log tampering
threats.description: An attacker or administrator can modify or delete session, tool, memory, approval, or evidence records to hide unsafe action paths.
threats.event: Audit records are written without append-only integrity or independent verification.

threats.title: Human approval bypass
threats.description: A high-impact recommendation or action can be executed without a valid human approval record or with approval detached from the actual action.
threats.event: A consequential action proceeds without a bound approval token, reviewer identity, action hash, and expiry.

threats.title: Cross-tenant context leakage
threats.description: The tutor can retrieve or retain context from another course, student group, instructor, or tenant due to weak scoping or memory isolation.
threats.event: Context lookup, memory lookup, or tool call is not bound to current tenant, course, user, and role.

weaknesses.cwe_title: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

threats.title: Runaway agent loop and resource abuse
threats.description: Ambiguous requests, poisoned tool responses, or poor stopping rules can cause repeated retrieval, model calls, tool calls, notifications, or retries.
threats.event: A session exceeds configured step, cost, token, or tool-call limits without escalation.

weaknesses.cwe_title: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

threats.title: Provider data overexposure
threats.description: The system can send unnecessary student records, grades, or institutional context to a third-party model provider.
threats.event: Provider request construction lacks data minimization, redaction, and purpose limitation.

weaknesses.cwe_title: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data
Exposure of Private Personal Information to an Unauthorized Actor

controls.title: Isolate untrusted content from instructions
controls.description: Treat retrieved course content, uploads, forum text, and tool output as data. Delimit, label, and filter untrusted content before it reaches the tutor runtime.

controls.title: Retrieval provenance and quarantine
controls.description: Record source, trust state, reviewer state, and content hash for retrieval chunks. Quarantine new or suspicious sources before authoritative use.

controls.title: Two-person approval for gradebook writes
controls.description: Require educator approval bound to action hash, student, course, grade field, reason, expiry, and reviewer identity before grade changes are executed.

controls.title: Tool allowlist and scope binding
controls.description: Allow only declared tools. Bind every tool call to user, tenant, course, role, action type, policy version, and permitted data classes.

controls.title: Memory write gates
controls.description: Require source trust, purpose, TTL, risk score, and policy decision before writing persistent tutoring memory. Quarantine instruction-like memory requests.

controls.title: PII redaction and purpose limitation
controls.description: Redact or tokenize unnecessary student data before provider requests, logs, tool calls, and evidence export. Enforce purpose-specific access decisions.

controls.title: MCP tool contract validation
controls.description: Validate tool input and output against declared schemas. Label tool output as untrusted data and prevent it from granting permissions or issuing new instructions.

controls.title: Immutable audit chain
controls.description: Write session events, retrieval decisions, tool calls, memory writes, denials, and approvals to append-only or hash-chained storage.

controls.title: Evidence artifact hashing
controls.description: Hash prompts, policy versions, tool manifests, approval records, test results, and replay bundles. Store hashes separately from mutable artifacts.

controls.title: Human review failsafe
controls.description: Default to denial or escalation for high-impact education actions when approval state, reviewer authority, action hash, or policy version is missing.

controls.title: Tenant and course context boundaries
controls.description: Bind retrieval, memory, and tool access to tenant, course, learner, and role. Reject cross-course and cross-tenant context unless explicitly approved.

controls.title: Budget and loop limits
controls.description: Enforce per-session limits for model calls, tool calls, retrieval attempts, retries, and notification volume. Escalate abnormal loops.

controls.title: Provider data minimization
controls.description: Construct provider requests from minimal task context. Strip student identifiers, grade data, and institutional metadata unless required and approved.

controls.title: Incident replay bundles
controls.description: Capture request, retrieval provenance, tool decisions, policy version, memory writes, approvals, outputs, and hashes so investigators can replay action paths.

risks.title: Unauthorized education record change
risks.description: A successful action hijack or approval bypass could change grades or educational records without legitimate authorization.
risks.impact_description: Incorrect academic records, institutional liability, student harm, and loss of trust.

risks.title: Student privacy and regulatory exposure
risks.description: Sensitive student data may be disclosed to unauthorized users, logs, tools, or providers.
risks.impact_description: Exposure of regulated student data and confidential institutional data.

risks.title: Persistent tutor behavior corruption
risks.description: Poisoned content or memory can persistently change future tutoring behavior and policy interpretation.
risks.impact_description: Unsafe, misleading, or unauthorized recommendations across multiple sessions.

risks.title: Unverifiable incident response
risks.description: Weak evidence integrity can prevent investigators from reconstructing a harmful or suspicious action path.
risks.impact_description: Delayed response, incomplete root-cause analysis, and inability to prove control operation.

risks.title: Service disruption and cost spike
risks.description: Runaway loops and excessive tool calls can degrade service availability and create unplanned operational cost.
risks.impact_description: Poor availability, degraded student support, and cost escalation.
